name: Create software system modeling diagrams
description: Users asked to generate, code, or describe software modeling diagrams, specifically focusing on UML elements like class, sequence, and use case diagrams, as well as other standard notations such as ER, IDEF0, and BPMN. The requests frequently required these representations to be based on specific source code, business scenarios, or system requirements, with variations in output formats including PlantUML, Mermaid, or textual descriptions.
